def has_1pos_and_kwonly(func):
    """Check if a function has exactly one positional argument and at least one keyword-only argument."""
    original = getattr(func, '__original__', None) or unwrap(func)
    if PY2:
        # Python 2 has no keyword-only arguments
        return False
    spec = inspect.signature(original)
    params = list(spec.parameters.values())
    pos_count = 0
    kwonly_count = 0
    for p in params:
        if p.kind == p.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD or p.kind == p.POSITIONAL_ONLY:
            pos_count += 1
        elif p.kind == p.KEYWORD_ONLY:
            kwonly_count += 1
        # VAR_POSITIONAL and VAR_KEYWORD don't count
    return pos_count == 1 and kwonly_count >= 1
